semantic.justification: Native wwFont FFN identity and implicit copy preserve primary/alternate mapping,65unit limit, byte narrowing, pitch/family flags, legacy weight400 and charset. Original memcmp+UTF16-name ordering defines map identity. wwFontHelper copies inserted map keys, assigns narrowed insertion IDs and materializes vectors by ID rather than sorted order. No font DTO/provider or invented ID callback. Font-table initialization through MSWordExportBase, DOCX/XML/embedding, binary/RTF output, actual DocxExport association and complete format orchestration remain pending. The current paragraph-style graph uses pinned reserved Word slots and source collection order; full style vocabulary remains unverified. V4DQJW connects wwFont.WriteDocx and wwFontHelper.WriteFontTable to actual DocxAttributeOutput. Preserve empty-family omission, alternate-name admission, charset/family/pitch element order and ID-ordered font traversal. Only native font metadata is admitted for the current kernel without embedding; EmbedFont/doc-setting/native font-access responsibilities are unported and not replaced by dummy services. Existing shared RTF MSWordStyles behavior is unchanged.
